title: Late-night enquiry, admission season
summary: Replay with simulated data, combining the WhatsApp auto-reply bot and the enquiry tracker. At 9:42 pm a parent asks Brightpath Tutorials on WhatsApp about class 8 maths batch timings and fees. The bot answers from the centre's own list and offers a free demo class. The parent asks for Saturday; the bot says it has passed the request to the centre. On the centre's side the enquiry is logged in the Enquiries sheet as Demo requested, and the owner gets a Telegram alert to confirm. The next morning the owner confirms Saturday at 11 and the row changes to Demo booked.

steps.text: Hi, what are the batch timings for class 8 maths? And the fees?
Hello! Class 8 maths runs Mon, Wed and Fri, 5 to 6 pm. This term's fees are on our Classes page. Would your child like a free demo class first?
Yes please. Can he come on Saturday?
I've passed your request for a Saturday demo to the centre. They'll confirm the time here.
Demo request: class 8 maths, Saturday, from ••• 5520. Batch timings and fees already sent.
Good morning! Saturday at 11 is confirmed for the demo class. See you both then.
